model.title: Clarity for Compensation Act
model.meta: Financial Services Committee · Rep. Zachary Nunn (R-IA)

summary.text: The bill would exempt certain small, representative-owned personal services businesses from being classified as brokers under securities law, reducing their regulatory burden. It aims to clarify the regulatory status of these entities so they can operate more flexibly while still maintaining appropriate oversight.
